governing_story: EVIDENCE DEFINES WHAT CAN BE KNOWN
METHODS EXPOSE HOW IT WAS TESTED
BOUNDARIES SHOW WHERE THE CLAIM STOPS

root_landing.page_role: Establish the entire chamber, preserve the Laws Compass as navigation authority, and allow visitors to enter any authority while understanding the controlling story.
root_landing.question_answered: How do real research, the four Laws, Test, and Research work together as one chamber?
root_landing.presentation_rule: The landing page provides the whole-system orientation and a small number of study examples. It is not a second study directory.

authority_roles.FLOW: Movement, change, recurrence, return, and transfer.
authority_roles.REALITY: Theory, evidence, measurement, interpretation, and limits.
authority_roles.STRUCTURE: Constraints, interfaces, boundaries, dependencies, governance, and admissible states.
authority_roles.TEST: Admission, forward construction, reverse challenge, result disposition, and record custody.
authority_roles.RESEARCH: Real investigations, evidence, methods, findings, uncertainty, unresolved work, and return to the complete Frontier record.

shared_presentation_standard.typography: One shared modern sans-serif system with page-specific hierarchy.
shared_presentation_standard.atmosphere: One chamber atmosphere with authority-specific depth, motion, and visual accent; consistency must not become sameness.
shared_presentation_standard.hero: Every page receives a page-specific hero built around one direct question.
shared_presentation_standard.primary_lens: Exactly one of PRACTICAL, ENGINEERING, or EMPIRICAL is active on entry. The other two remain available as page-specific lenses.
shared_presentation_standard.disclosures: Nested detail and canonical audit disclosures are closed by default.
shared_presentation_standard.formula_and_relationship_delivery: Equations, thresholds, causal chains, state diagrams, or relationship maps must be structured and legible rather than terminal-style decoration.
shared_presentation_standard.lens_separation: Practical, Engineering, and Empirical claims remain visibly distinct and cannot silently substitute for one another.
shared_presentation_standard.claim_boundary: Every page exposes a plain-language claim boundary before the audit layer.
shared_presentation_standard.story_navigation: Every page displays previous and next story context. Direct entry remains allowed; the sequence is explanatory, not a forced wizard.
shared_presentation_standard.audit_access: Each route owns one collapsed canonical audit record rather than reproducing implementation history in the public layer.
shared_presentation_standard.mobile: Mobile composition is designed independently, with one primary idea visible before secondary lenses and audit detail.
shared_presentation_standard.route_authority: Existing route and Compass navigation authority remains unchanged until a separately authorized implementation operation.

non_duplication_rules: Child pages do not repeat the authority-family introduction.
Child pages do not reproduce the complete selected study.
Research pages divide study context by investigation, evidence, method, and findings.
Test pages divide one selected study by admission, forward construction, reverse audit, and result custody.
Law pages expose only materially relevant recurring relationships.
Audit records preserve custody and implementation facts behind progressive disclosure.

canonical_story_traversal_rule.final_return: The last Laws interpretation returns to the current complete Frontier study record.

freeze_gate.representative_selection_basis: One signal-oriented law page, one quantitative law page, one adversarial Test page, and one Research synthesis page establish the shared system across distinct narrative functions.
